messages:
Rina (Finance): quick one for month-end - customer paid a 6-month prepaid for Dedicated capacity plus a one-time onboarding credit they can draw down. how should we handle deferral vs immediate recognition for the onboarding credit?
Noah (Accounting): onboarding credit is a separate deliverable. if it's a service credit the customer consumes over time, defer and recognize over the period of benefit. if it's promotional and consumed immediately, recognize when redeemed. need contract language.
Zoe (RevOps): contract: 'Customer receives $10,000 onboarding credit to apply against usage; credit expires after 6 months. Credit is non-refundable.'
Rina (Finance): sounds like time-based benefit. proposal: defer credit as a reduction to revenue (contra-rev) and amortize over 6 months matching service. journal suggestions?
Noah (Accounting): yes. example entries: 
- On receipt (Apr 2): Dr Cash 60,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 60,000 (prepay for 6mo pool) 
- Record onboarding credit liability: Dr Deferred Revenue 10,000 / Cr Deferred Credit Liability 2415 (or record as contra-rev schedule) 
- Monthly recognition (Apr-Sep): Dr Deferred Revenue 50,000/6 = 8,333 / Cr Revenue 4001; release onboarding credit proportionally when used or ratably if expected to be used.
Rina (Finance): for the close ticket I'll use GLs: DefRev 2305, ContraRev 4015, Cash 1002. Noah, do you want to post the JE in the close system?
deploy-bot: Created close ticket CT-4478 with schedules DEF-8810 (prepay) and CONTRA-331 (onboarding credit).
Noah (Accounting): will post JE shortly; I'll include backup: contract excerpt + rev schedule. If customers rarely use full credit, we may estimate breakage later.
Zoe (RevOps): noted. i'll add usage redemptions extract to the ticket so actual consumption can be reconciled before we finalize month close.
Rina (Finance): thanks team. closing once JE is posted and schedule reconciled. :white_check_mark:
